text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. The purpose of this report is to recommend installing stop controls for eastbound traffic on Angelone Lane at Woodmount Avenue to clearly establish right-of-way and enhance pedestrian, cyclist and vehicular safety.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated Woodmount Avenue as a through highway from the north side of Danforth Avenue to the south side of Strathmore Boulevard.
